Lateral lobes exhibit high-intensity (white) fields with dense, irregular low-intensity (black) mottling and focal spots concentrated near the inner margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations of 5-12 pixels create a jagged profile, particularly prominent on the upper distal margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertical and diagonal high-contrast linear disruptions detected on the central black pigmentation, consistent with scratch-pattern pixel irregularities.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple high-contrast avian shapes (birds) in the surrounding water pixels, providing scale and context to the fluke's position.
